items.title: Meta 發布首個前沿 AI 模型 Muse Wonder，主打代理任務與主動記憶
items.title_en: Meta Releases First Frontier AI Models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full
items.summary: Meta 超智能實驗室推出 Muse Wonder 及 Muse Wonder Full，為公司首批前沿模型，效能媲美市場頂尖競品，具備主動記憶功能，透過 Meta Model API 向開發者開放，定價每百萬輸入 token 4 美元、輸出 20 美元。
items.summary_en: Meta's Superintelligence Lab launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier AI models featuring active memory capabilities, benchmarking against top rivals at $4 input / $20 output per million tokens via the Meta Model API.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: Meta 正式跨入前沿模型競賽，將重塑其廣告 AI 能力的發展路線圖，代理商需追蹤 Advantage+ 等產品的升級時間表。
items.why_en: Meta entering frontier AI reshapes its ad-product roadmap; agencies should track how Muse Wonder capabilities feed into Advantage+ and AI-driven campaign automation.
highlights: Meta 超智能實驗室推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，為公司首批前沿級模型，主攻法律、金融、醫療等專業代理任務。
模型具備「主動記憶」功能，可跨對話記住用戶偏好與歷史指令，推理效能對標業界頂尖競品。

highlights_en: Meta's Superintelligence Lab launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier-class models targeting professional agentic tasks in law, finance, and healthcare.
The models feature 'active memory' that retains user preferences across sessions, with performance benchmarks matching leading rivals.
Available now via Meta Model API at $4/$20 per million tokens; Muse Wonder Full is exclusive to Muse Code subscribers.
items.pattern: Meta 從廣告平台跨入自研前沿模型研發，意味其廣告系統將逐步由自研模型驅動，代理商應密切追蹤 Meta AI 能力如何滲透 Advantage+ 及 Reels 廣告的自動化創作流程。
items.pattern_en: Meta's frontier model entry signals its ad systems will increasingly run on proprietary AI — agencies should track how Muse Wonder capabilities integrate into Advantage+ creative automation and Reels ad generation over the next two quarters.
items.detail:
Meta 超智能實驗室此次推出的 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，是該公司在 AI 發展路線上一次重要的架構轉型。與前代輕量低延遲的 Muse Spark 相比，Wonder 系列主打的是大規模複雜任務能力，涵蓋多步驟代理工作流程以及進階程式編寫。在業界標準測試集上，Wonder 的成績與 Fable 5.1 及 GPT-6 Astra 相當，顯示 Meta 已正式躋身第一梯隊前沿模型的競逐行列，而非僅在效率模型市場上競爭。

兩款模型的差異化定位值得關注。Muse Wonder 透過 Meta Model API 向開發者全面開放，定價為每百萬輸入 token 4 美元、輸出 20 美元，與 GPT-6 Sol 或 Opus 5.5 的售價區間相近，意在以性價比吸引企業開發者。Muse Wonder Full 則是更高規格的版本，目前僅供 Muse Code 訂閱用戶使用，並無對外 API，形成封閉的高端產品線。兩款模型皆為 Muse 智能代理的核心驅動引擎，說明 Meta 的商業意圖是以模型能力帶動代理應用生態。

最受矚目的技術突破在於「主動記憶」功能。研究科學家 Kavya Kopparapu 解釋，這項設計的核心在於讓模型能夠在數天、數週乃至數月的跨對話跨任務場景中，持續保留並綜合對用戶而言重要的資訊。Wonder 在 MemoryBench 記憶基準測試上的成績亦勝過 Fable、Opus 與 Astra，驗證此能力並非行銷話術。對企業客戶而言，長期記憶意味著代理可以跨工作階段維持一致的個人化設定，大幅降低重複提示的成本。

基礎設施方面，Wonder 系列於 2026 年啟用的俄亥俄州 Prometheus 資料中心完成訓練，反映 Meta 近年在自建算力上的大規模投入正在兌現回報。組織背景上，此次發布是 Scale AI 創辦人 Alexandr Wang 於 2025 年 8 月重組 Meta AI 部門後的首批前沿成果，標誌著 Meta 將 AI 視為「通往個人超智能下一步」的戰略論述，正逐漸由願景轉化為可量測的產品里程碑。
items.detail_en:
Meta's Superintelligence Lab has released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, marking the company's formal entry into the frontier model tier. Unlike the lightweight, low-latency Muse Spark, the Wonder series is built for complex, multi-step agentic workflows and advanced coding tasks. On standard benchmarks, Wonder scores are comparable to Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra, confirming Meta has moved beyond competing solely in the efficiency model segment.

The two models carry distinct positioning. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, pricing that aligns with GPT-6 Sol and Opus 5.5 and targets enterprise developers on a cost-performance basis. Muse Wonder Full is a higher-capability variant exclusive to Muse Code subscribers, with no external API access, forming a closed premium tier. Both models serve as the core engines powering the Muse agent, signaling that Meta's commercial intent is to use model capability to anchor a broader agentic application ecosystem.

The standout technical feature is Active Memory. Research scientist Kavya Kopparapu described the design goal as ensuring the model can retain and synthesize what matters to a user across days, weeks, and months of sessions and tasks. Wonder's lead over Fable, Opus, and Astra on MemoryBench—a continual learning and memory recall benchmark—substantiates this claim beyond marketing language. For enterprise deployments, persistent memory means agents can maintain consistent personalized context across work sessions, significantly reducing the overhead of repeated prompting.

The models were trained at Meta's Prometheus data center in central Ohio, which opened in 2026, reflecting the returns now materializing from Meta's sustained infrastructure investment. Organizationally, this release is the first frontier output since Scale AI founder Alexandr Wang restructured Meta AI in August 2025. Meta has described the Wonder series as the next step on its scaling ladder and a major leap toward personal superintelligence—a strategic narrative that is now backed by measurable product milestones rather than forward projections alone.

items.title: 智谱 GLM-5.3-Highspeed 達每秒 490 字元，百萬 context 長文推理速度躍升
items.title_en: Zhipu GLM-5.3-Highspeed Hits 490 Tokens/s with 1M Context Window
items.summary: 智谱 AI 旗下 GLM-5.3-Highspeed 最新測試達每秒 490 字元，遠超前代 FlashX 的 200 TPS，支援百萬字元 context 視窗及三段推理強度，目前限量向 Zcode 3.15.1 訂閱用戶開放。
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3-Highspeed model recorded 490 tokens/s in testing — more than double the previous FlashX's 200 TPS — with a 1M token context window and three reasoning tiers, currently rolling out to select Zcode 3.15.1 subscribers.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: GLM 速度突破使中文長文批量生成成本下降，對需要大量中文內容輸出的大灣區代理商具有直接應用價值。
items.why_en: GLM-5.3's speed leap cuts the cost of bulk Chinese content generation, directly benefiting GBA agencies running high-volume copywriting or social content workflows.
highlights: GLM-5.3-Highspeed 最新測試達每秒 490 字元，為上月 FlashX 的 2.4 倍，生成一萬字元僅需約 20 秒。
支援百萬字元 context 視窗與最高 13.1 萬字元輸出，並提供低、高、最高三段推理強度設定。
目前限量向 Zcode 3.15.1 訂閱用戶隨機開放，大規模商用定價尚未公布。
highlights_en: GLM-5.3-Highspeed reached 490 tokens/s in tests — 2.4× faster than last month's FlashX — generating 10,000 tokens in approximately 20 seconds.
Supports a 1M token context window with up to 131,072 tokens output, plus three reasoning intensity tiers: low, high, and max.
Currently rolling out to select Zcode 3.15.1 subscribers; large-scale commercial pricing has not yet been announced.
items.detail:
智谱 AI 推出的 GLM-5.3-Highspeed 在最新測試中錄得每秒 490 字元的生成速度，相較同系列的 FlashX 版本（約 200 TPS），速度提升幅度逾一倍。以實際體感換算，生成一萬字元的內容僅需約 20 秒，對於需要即時回饋的代碼補全、長文起草及多輪問答場景，這一數字具有明顯的實用意義。對照整個 GLM-5 系列的速度分佈——標準 Flash 版本在 Z.ai API 上僅達每秒 60 字元，上一代 Highspeed（5.1 版，2026 年 5 月）則約為 400 TPS——可見智谱在推理效率上的進展並非線性漸進，而是跳躍式提升。

技術規格上，GLM-5.3-Highspeed 延續了旗艦版的完整能力架構，支援高達百萬字元（1,000,000 tokens）的 context 視窗，最大輸出長度為 131,072 tokens（約 128k），並提供 low、high、max 三檔推理強度供使用者按需調配。這意味著使用者既可選用輕量推理快速輸出，亦可在複雜邏輯推導任務上切換至深度思考模式，讓速度與精度之間有更細緻的取捨空間。百萬字元 context 支援長文檔分析與跨文件代碼審閱的工作流程，是目前業界規模最大的 context 視窗之一。

就市場定位而言，此次推出採取了分層灰度策略：GLM-5.3-Highspeed 目前僅在 Zcode 3.15.1 版本中隨機向訂閱用戶推送，Lite 層級用戶尚未普遍獲得存取權限。有用戶形容其使用體驗為「速度快，思考久，效果還蠻好」，即高速生成與相對深入的推理過程並存。此外，網路上有未經證實的說法，指 GLM-5.3-Highspeed 可能與 OpenCode 平台上 2026 年 9 月新增的匿名模型 Omen Alpha 存在關聯，然而智谱尚未官方確認兩者的關係。

從行業視角看，推理速度本身正逐漸從模型的輔助參數升格為核心競爭維度。對於代碼助手、即時翻譯及廣告文案批量生成等對延遲敏感的業務場景，每秒 490 字元代表一條可落地使用的基準線。智谱以速度突破切入開發者工具鏈，與 Meta 及 Anthropic 側重代理能力與長期記憶的路線形成差異化，反映出主流模型廠商在前沿能力以外，正積極以工程效率爭奪實際部署市場。
items.detail_en:
GLM-5.3-Highspeed from Zhipu AI has recorded a generation speed of 490 tokens per second in the latest user tests, more than double the throughput of the GLM-5.3-FlashX variant at approximately 200 TPS. In practical terms, generating 10,000 tokens takes roughly 20 seconds at this rate—a meaningful threshold for latency-sensitive applications such as real-time code completion, long-form drafting, and multi-turn dialogue. Placing this in the context of the broader GLM-5 family—standard Flash on the Z.ai API runs at around 60 TPS, and the previous-generation GLM-5.1-Highspeed from May 2026 reached approximately 400 TPS—the efficiency gains are non-linear and represent a step change rather than incremental tuning.

On the specification side, GLM-5.3-Highspeed retains the full capability architecture of the flagship version. It supports a one-million-token context window, a maximum output length of 131,072 tokens (approximately 128k), and three selectable reasoning intensities—low, high, and max—allowing users to balance speed against depth depending on task complexity. The million-token context enables workflows involving large document analysis and cross-file code review, placing it among the widest context windows currently available in production models.

The rollout follows a tiered approach: GLM-5.3-Highspeed is currently being pushed selectively to Zcode 3.15.1 subscribers on a randomized basis, with Lite-tier users not yet broadly covered. Early users describe the experience as fast output paired with noticeably longer reasoning time and solid accuracy. Unconfirmed speculation in developer communities links the model to Omen Alpha, an anonymous model added to OpenCode in September 2026, though Zhipu has not officially commented on any connection.

At the industry level, inference speed is increasingly a primary competitive dimension rather than a secondary metric. For developer tooling, real-time translation, and high-volume ad copy generation, 490 TPS establishes a practical deployment baseline. Zhipu's focus on engineering throughput offers a differentiated position relative to Meta and Anthropic, which are emphasizing agentic capability and long-term memory, reflecting how leading model vendors are now competing on operational efficiency to capture production deployments beyond the frontier benchmark leaderboards.

items.title: 微軟總裁 Brad Smith：英國最具資格主導全球 AI 監管框架
items.title_en: Microsoft President Brad Smith Says UK Is Best Placed to Lead Global AI Regulation
items.summary: 微軟總裁 Brad Smith 呼籲制定具約束力的 AI 法規，指英國 AISI 因不帶歐盟政治包袱而具獨特優勢，倡議強制性漏洞通報法、前置第三方審計及 AI 緊急制動機制。
items.summary_en: Microsoft President Brad Smith urged binding AI legislation, naming the UK's AI Security Institute as best-positioned globally to lead, and calling for mandatory breach-notification laws, pre-release third-party audits, and AI kill-switch requirements.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 監管框架定型將直接影響前沿模型的部署時間表與廣告科技合規成本，代理商須提前追蹤立法進展。
items.why_en: A binding AI regulatory framework will shape frontier model deployment timelines and adtech compliance costs; agencies should track UK AISI developments as a leading indicator for Asia-Pacific rules.
highlights: 微軟總裁 Brad Smith 呼籲各國政府盡快立法，點名英國 AISI 為最佳全球監管主導方，理由是英國不受歐盟政治博弈牽制。
Smith 提出三項具體政策主張：強制性 AI 漏洞通報法、前置第三方審計，以及 AI 系統必須具備緊急制動機制。
英國 AISI 確認仍保有測試前沿模型的權限，未受近期美國政治壓力影響，維持獨立評估地位。
highlights_en: Microsoft President Brad Smith urged urgent AI legislation, naming the UK's AISI as the best-positioned global body — free from EU political entanglements — to lead.
Smith proposed three concrete policies: mandatory AI breach-notification laws, pre-release third-party audits, and required AI kill-switch capabilities.
The UK AI Security Institute confirmed it retains authority to test frontier models, unaffected by recent US political pressure on its independence.
items.followup: 10 月 11 日我們報過微軟 CEO Satya Nadella 呼籲為 AI 系統設置「緊急制動」機制。今日輪到微軟總裁 Brad Smith 提出更具體的監管路線圖：點名英國 AISI 為最佳主導方，並倡議強制性漏洞通報法與前置第三方審計——從 Nadella 的「需要制動」走向 Smith 的「由英國帶頭立規」，微軟正在系統性地主導全球 AI 監管討論。
items.followup_en: On October 11 we covered Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella's call for an AI emergency brake. Today Microsoft President Brad Smith maps a concrete regulatory path: naming the UK's AISI as the best candidate to lead globally, and calling for mandatory breach-notification laws and pre-release third-party audits — from Nadella's 'we need brakes' to Smith's 'here's who should build them.'
items.detail:
微軟總裁 Brad Smith 近日公開呼籲制定具法律約束力的 AI 監管框架，並點名英國是最具條件主導這一進程的國家。Smith 的核心論點建立在一個看似弔詭的比較上：普通消費品如牛奶與家用電器，受到的監管審查遠比同等影響力的 AI 系統更為嚴格，這種不對等折射出政策滯後於技術現實的深層矛盾。

Smith 指出，英國 AI 安全研究院（AISI）自 2023 年成立以來，已建立了在前沿 AI 模型正式部署前取得存取權限進行評估的制度安排，這在全球主要科技市場中屬於先例。英國之所以優於美國或歐盟，Smith 認為關鍵在於政治中立性：「在華盛頓，人們看英國的眼光與看布魯塞爾截然不同，這是英國的優勢。」歐盟的 AI 法案雖具里程碑意義，卻背負了成員國利益博弈的政治包袱；美國在聯邦層面迄今缺乏統一立法。英國的位置使其能在美歐之間扮演可信的中介角色。

Smith 對自願性自我監管的立場明確保留：他將白宮科技峰會的相關文件描述為「良好的起步」，隨即補充指出，自願機制的根本缺陷在於只有盡責的企業才會遵守，「你真正需要擔心的，恰恰是那些不那麼負責任的公司」。這一邏輯是他力主強制性法規的核心依據。就具體政策建議而言，Smith 提出三項措施：其一，在 AI 代理失控或出現惡意行為時，強制要求企業依法通報漏洞；其二，在任何 AI 產品正式上市前，須取得獨立第三方評估機構的書面核准；其三，建立 AI 緊急制動機制，當人類對系統的掌控出現實質性喪失時，能夠強制暫停運作。

Smith 此番表態的時機同樣值得注意。就在 2026 年 10 月 12 日，有報道指出特朗普政府曾要求 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 向英國測試人員暫停提供模型存取，而 AISI 隨後確認存取安排並未中斷。這一插曲側面印證了 AI 監管的地緣政治張力，也使 Smith 強調英國獨立性優勢的論述更具即時的政策背景。Smith 將 AI 同時定性為「武器與工具」，並指其帶來的網絡安全風險已屬全球性質，這一框架為跨國監管協調提供了論述支撐。
items.detail_en:
Microsoft President Brad Smith has publicly called for binding AI regulation and named the United Kingdom as the country best positioned to lead the process globally. His central argument rests on a pointed comparison: everyday consumer goods such as milk and household appliances face more rigorous regulatory scrutiny than AI systems with comparable or greater societal impact, an asymmetry that reflects a structural lag between policy frameworks and technological reality.

Smith highlighted the UK's AI Security Institute, established in 2023, as the institutional foundation for this leadership role. AISI already holds pre-deployment access to frontier AI models from leading developers—an arrangement that is genuinely novel among major technology markets. Smith's case for the UK over the US or EU turns on political neutrality: as he put it, in Washington people do not view the UK the way they view Brussels, and that difference is a strategic asset. The EU's AI Act carries the weight of member-state political negotiations, while the US has not achieved unified federal AI legislation. The UK's position allows it to serve as a credible intermediary between the two blocs.

Smith reserved clear skepticism for voluntary self-regulation, describing the White House tech summit document as a good step while immediately noting its structural limitation: only responsible actors comply with voluntary commitments, and the companies that pose the greatest risk are precisely those least likely to follow through. This logic underpins his three specific policy proposals: a legal obligation for companies to report breaches caused by rogue AI agents; mandatory approval from an independent outside evaluator before any AI product is released; and the establishment of kill switches that can halt AI systems when human oversight is materially lost.

The timing of Smith's remarks carries its own significance. On the same day, October 12, 2026, reports emerged that the Trump administration had asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold model access from UK testers, a claim AISI confirmed was not reflected in actual practice. That episode underscores the geopolitical dimensions of AI governance that Smith's framework is navigating. By describing AI as simultaneously a weapon and a tool carrying global cybersecurity risks, Smith frames cross-border regulatory coordination not as a jurisdictional question but as a shared security imperative.

items.title: 蘋果 Safari 封鎖廣告追蹤，eCPM 首週跌逾一成，Q4 前夕業界計算損失
items.title_en: Ad Industry Tallies Early Losses from Apple's Safari Tracking Block as eCPMs Drop 10.5%
items.summary: 蘋果 Safari 最新更新在無預告下封鎖主要廣告追蹤商，首週 eCPM 跌幅達 10.5%，The Trade Desk 廣告伺服器遭屏蔽，修復最快須待十月底，目前更新覆蓋率僅約 8%，全面衝擊尚未到來。
items.summary_en: Apple's latest Safari update silently blocked major ad-tracking vendors, with eCPMs dropping 10.5% among affected users in week one; The Trade Desk's ad server was blocked and won't be fixed until late October, while only ~8% of users have updated so far.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 程序化廣告 Q4 收益直接受創，依賴跨站追蹤的代理商須立即評估第一方數據替代方案以減低衝擊。
items.why_en: Q4 programmatic revenue is directly hit; agencies relying on cross-site identity tracking should urgently evaluate first-party data alternatives before the full iOS user base updates.
highlights: 蘋果 Safari 更新在無事先通知下封鎖主要廣告追蹤商，程序化買方受影響用戶的 eCPM 首週平均跌幅達 10.5%。
The Trade Desk 廣告伺服器遭屏蔽後已獲臨時修復，惟針對 iOS Safari 的完整修補最快需等至十月底。
目前只有約 8% 用戶完成 iOS 更新，隨著更新率上升，衝擊將進一步擴大，預計在 Q4 旺季高峰期達到最大規模。
highlights_en: Apple's Safari update silently blocked major ad-tracking vendors with no advance notice; early data shows eCPMs down an average of 10.5% among affected users in week one.
The Trade Desk's ad server was blocked but temporarily patched; a full fix for iOS Safari won't reach users until late October.
Only ~8% of users have updated so far — as the update rate rises heading into Q4, the full scale of impact is still ahead.
