items.followup_en: On October 8 we reported iOS 27's ad-tech blacklist, with The Trade Desk and LiveRamp among the first blocked. Today Digiday quantifies the first-week damage: eCPMs down 10.5%, The Trade Desk's ad server fix won't reach users until late October — and only ~8% of users have updated, meaning the full impact is still ahead as Q4 peaks.
items.pattern: 每次 iOS 大版本更新都帶來新一波廣告技術淘汰，短期 eCPM 跌幅已可預期；長線受惠方是已建立第一方數據資產的品牌，以及能協助客戶完成數據圍牆遷移的代理商。
items.pattern_en: Each major iOS update triggers another round of ad-tech attrition. Short-term eCPM drops are now predictable; long-term beneficiaries are brands with first-party data assets and agencies that can guide clients through the walled-garden transition.
items.detail:
蘋果此次對 Safari 廣告追蹤商的封鎖，在操作方式上與 2017 年及 2021 年的舊例存在關鍵差異：被列入封鎖名單的廠商清單由蘋果單方面決定且不對外公開，業界人士坦言幾乎無從事先掌握被列名的標準。這種資訊不對稱，使各方難以制定系統性的應對策略，只能在衝擊顯現後逐一核查自身是否受影響。

廣告技術平台 Aditude 提供的數據揭示了衝擊的初步輪廓。在其服務的發行商群體中，Safari（涵蓋 iPhone 及 iPad）的廣告流量佔比為 11.7%，對應廣告收入佔比為 11.4%。在已升級至最新版 iOS 的用戶群中，eCPM 跌幅達到 10.5%。由於截至報道時間，僅約 8% 的用戶完成了版本升級，整體發行商的實際收入損失目前估算僅約 1%。這一數字具有強烈的前瞻警示意義：隨著更新覆蓋率在 Q4 旺季持續攀升，損失將以倍數級別放大。

The Trade Desk 廣告伺服器遭封鎖一事呈現了此次事件的另一層複雜性。有工程師發現該廣告伺服器在蘋果的一個測試版 iOS 中已從封鎖名單移除，但現役版本的用戶仍無法使用。Index Exchange 執行長 Andrew Casale 就此提問：「這算是恢復，還是承認了一個相當重大的錯誤？」最快的修復時間線預計要到十月底才能實現，時值 Q4 廣告旺季的衝刺期，對依賴程序化購買的發行商而言，時機尤為不利。Casale 亦對蘋果在應用程式與網頁端截然不同的態度直言批評：「看到他們在網頁端如此隨意的行為方式，著實令人震驚。」

業界對蘋果動機的解讀集中在競爭利益層面。一位發行商高層以「明目張膽」形容此舉，並指出任何令廣告投放變得更困難的措施，最終都有利於蘋果自身的廣告業務——蘋果搜尋廣告與 App Store 廣告位的收入體量近年持續增長。IAB Tech Lab 曾多次試圖與蘋果就隱私政策展開對話，自 2010 年代末至今收效甚微，反映出蘋果在生態系統規則上的單邊主義立場有其一貫性。諮詢顧問 Davide Rosamilia 的評語幾乎是業界共識的濃縮：「情況不會好轉，只會繼續惡化。」對於在 Safari 流量上佈置了較多程序化廣告資源的發行商，現在或許是重新評估收入結構多元化的關鍵窗口。
items.detail_en:
Apple's latest Safari tracking block differs from its 2017 and 2021 predecessors in one critical operational respect: the blocklist is determined unilaterally and kept confidential, meaning the industry has no visible criteria against which to assess exposure in advance. This information asymmetry makes systematic preparation nearly impossible; affected parties can only audit their own situation after the impact has already materialized.

Data from ad technology platform Aditude provides the clearest early picture of scale. Across publishers using the platform, Safari—covering iPhone and iPad—accounts for 11.7% of ads served and 11.4% of ad revenue. Among users who have already upgraded to the latest iOS version, eCPMs dropped 10.5%. With approximately 8% of users updated as of the reporting date, the realized overall revenue impact is estimated at roughly 1%. That figure carries a compounding warning: as update rates climb through Q4, the most commercially valuable quarter of the advertising calendar, the damage will scale proportionally.

The Trade Desk's ad server situation adds a layer of ambiguity. Engineers discovered that the server had been quietly removed from the blocklist in a test iOS build following the filing of a bug report—yet current production users remain blocked, with a fix not expected until the end of October at the earliest. Index Exchange CEO Andrew Casale posed the question directly: is this a restoration, or an admission of a significant error? Casale also criticized the stark contrast between Apple's permissive approach in the app ecosystem and its behavior on the open web, describing it as quite shocking. The timing, arriving at the start of the most lucrative ad period of the year, compounds the commercial pressure on publishers dependent on programmatic buying.

Industry interpretation of Apple's motivation centers on competitive self-interest. One publisher executive described the move as blatant, arguing that anything making advertising more difficult ultimately benefits Apple's own advertising business—App Store and Apple Search Ads revenue has grown steadily in recent years. IAB Tech Lab's repeated attempts to engage Apple on privacy policy since the late 2010s have produced little measurable result, consistent with Apple's historical pattern of acting unilaterally on ecosystem rules. Consultant Davide Rosamilia's assessment that things will not improve and will only get worse appears to reflect a broad industry consensus. For publishers with significant programmatic exposure on Safari inventory, the current partial-coverage window may represent a final opportunity to reassess revenue diversification before full update rollout arrives.

items.title: Apple iOS 27 廣告封鎖範圍擴至數百家程序化數據供應商
items.title_en: Apple's iOS 27 Blocks Hundreds More Programmatic Data Companies Beyond Initial Names
items.summary: iOS 27 的廣告技術封鎖範圍據報已擴及數百家程序化數據公司，遠超最初曝光的 The Trade Desk 與 LiveRamp，代理商整條行動端受眾數據管道均面臨斷鏈風險。
items.summary_en: iOS 27's ad-tech restrictions reportedly extend to hundreds of programmatic data companies beyond the initially named vendors, putting agencies' entire mobile audience data pipelines at risk across the supply chain.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 擴大版封鎖將令更多廣告技術供應商失去行動端數據來源，代理商須提前部署第一方數據應對方案，而非等待個別供應商修復。
items.why_en: Wider iOS blocks will strip mobile data access from hundreds of ad-tech vendors; agencies must build first-party data infrastructure proactively rather than waiting for vendor-by-vendor patches.
highlights: iOS 27 的廣告技術封鎖範圍遠超最初披露的 The Trade Desk 和 LiveRamp，已擴及數百家程序化數據公司。
整個行動端程序化採購鏈受衝擊，從 DMP、DSP 到數據聚合商均受影響，供應商修復速度難以追上封鎖速度。
業界觀察人士警告，此趨勢將加速第三方行動受眾數據的長期式衰退，第一方數據策略成為代理商唯一可依賴的出口。
highlights_en: iOS 27's ad-tech blocks extend far beyond the initially disclosed vendors to hundreds of programmatic data companies across the supply chain.
The entire mobile programmatic pipeline is affected — DMPs, DSPs, and data aggregators all impacted — with vendors unable to patch fast enough to keep pace with Apple's restrictions.
Industry observers warn this accelerates the long-term structural decline of third-party mobile audience data, making first-party data strategy the only reliable path forward for agencies.
items.followup: 10 月 8 日我們報過 iOS 27 廣告科技黑名單，以 The Trade Desk 及 LiveRamp 為首受到封鎖。今日 Campaign Asia 披露封鎖範圍已大幅擴展至數百家程序化數據公司——遠超最初曝光的幾家，代理商整條行動端受眾數據管道均面臨斷鏈風險，事態遠比首報嚴峻。
items.followup_en: On October 8 we reported the iOS 27 blacklist targeting The Trade Desk and LiveRamp. Today Campaign Asia reveals the block has expanded dramatically to hundreds of programmatic data companies — far beyond the initial names — putting agencies' entire mobile data pipeline at risk. The situation is significantly worse than first reported.
items.detail:
Apple 在 iOS 27 中引入了一套基於 WebKit 的動態封鎖機制，其技術核心是「ContentRuleList」——一份存放於私人 GitHub 儲存庫的名單，可讓 Apple 隨時新增或移除廠商，無需推送系統更新。名單透過兩項新增的過濾條件運作：`isRequestToKnownCrossSiteTracker` 與 `!supportsFingerprintingScriptRequests`，前者攔截已知跨站追蹤器的請求，後者排除被判定支援指紋識別的指令碼。由於 iOS 強制所有瀏覽器採用 WebKit 引擎，封鎖效力延伸至 iPhone 與 iPad 上的每一款瀏覽器，而非僅限 Safari，覆蓋面遠超業界早期預期。

最初曝光時，被點名的公司以程序化廣告領域的重量級廠商為主，包括 The Trade Desk（及其共通 ID 方案 UID 2.0）、LiveRamp、ID5、Permutive，以及 Experian 旗下的 Audigent。其中 The Trade Desk 隨後獲部分「解封」，其廣告伺服器域名一度從名單中移除，令業界一時揣測 Apple 是否願意個別洽談。然而 AdExchanger 的後續報導顯示，受波及企業已從最初的個位數，迅速擴張至涵蓋數百家 CDP、廣告技術商、行銷技術商、資料售商及身份圖譜運營商，形成全面清掃之勢。

這份名單的存在令業界最感不安之處，在於它的「不透明性」：廠商可能在毫不知情的情況下遭到封鎖，直至流量或媒合率異常才被動察覺。IAB Tech Lab 的 Rowena Lam 指出，動態更新能力本身才是核心隱患，因為它讓任何廠商都無法確保自身地位的穩定性。投資銀行業人士亦坦言，若以當前形勢衡量，不會輕易押注於身份辨識公司的未來融資。相較之下，Zeta 旗下的 LiveIntent、Publicis 旗下的 Lotame 以及 Yahoo 的 ConnectID 暫未出現在名單中，但業界普遍認為名單仍在持續演進。

對代理商而言，此次封鎖帶來的衝擊並非抽象的技術問題，而是直接斬斷行動端受眾數據管道。以程序化採購為主的行動廣告活動，依賴這些廠商完成受眾辨識、頻率控制與跨裝置歸因，一旦第三方 ID 在 iOS 環境內全面失效，依靠 Safari 與 iPhone 用戶貢獻高價值流量的出版商同樣首當其衝。業界在 Advertising Week New York 期間的討論大多以匿名形式進行，多位高管坦言正在加速評估第一方數據策略與伺服器端方案，以尋求替代路徑。
items.detail_en:
Apple's iOS 27 introduced a dynamic blocking mechanism built on WebKit's "ContentRuleList" — a list stored in a private GitHub repository that Apple can update at any time without pushing a software release. The list operates through two new filter conditions: `isRequestToKnownCrossSiteTracker` and `!supportsFingerprintingScriptRequests`, the first intercepting requests from known cross-site trackers and the second excluding scripts deemed to support fingerprinting. Because iOS mandates WebKit for all browsers, the block extends to every browser on iPhone and iPad — not just Safari — a reach far exceeding what the industry initially anticipated.

When the story first broke, the named companies were heavyweights in programmatic advertising: The Trade Desk (and its UID 2.0 identity solution), LiveRamp, ID5, Permutive, and Experian's Audigent. The Trade Desk was subsequently granted a partial reprieve — its ad server domain was briefly removed from the list — leading some to speculate Apple might negotiate individually. However, subsequent AdExchanger reporting revealed the list had expanded from a handful of names to hundreds of CDPs, ad tech vendors, martech platforms, data sellers, and identity graph operators.

What unsettles the industry most about this list is its opacity: vendors may be added without any notification, only discovering their blocked status when traffic or match rates drop unexpectedly. IAB Tech Lab's Rowena Lam identified the dynamic-update capability as the core threat, since it means no vendor can rely on a stable status. Investment bankers noted they would not currently back a fundraise for an identity company. By contrast, Zeta's LiveIntent, Publicis-owned Lotame, and Yahoo's ConnectID have not appeared on the list — though the industry widely expects the list to keep evolving.

For agencies, the impact is not an abstract technical matter. It severs the mobile audience data pipeline for programmatic campaigns that rely on these vendors for audience identification, frequency capping, and cross-device attribution. Publishers who depend on Safari and iPhone users for premium inventory are equally exposed, as third-party IDs fail across the iOS environment. Most discussions at Advertising Week New York were held off the record, with executives accelerating evaluation of first-party data strategies and server-side solutions as alternative paths forward.

items.title: Honeyjar 推出 AI 公關平台，24 小時內累積逾萬名候補用戶
items.title_en: Honeyjar Launches AI PR Platform, Attracts 10,000 Waitlist Signups in 24 Hours
items.summary: 初創公司 Honeyjar 推出 AI 平台，協助各規模企業自動化新聞稿撰寫、媒體配對及發言機會搜尋，24 小時內累積逾萬名候補用戶，Nextdoor 等機構已參與測試。
items.summary_en: Startup Honeyjar launched an AI platform automating press releases, journalist matching, and speaking opportunity searches for companies of all sizes, attracting over 10,000 waitlist signups in 24 hours with beta testers including Nextdoor.
items.why: 代理商可評估 Honeyjar 作為客戶公關工作流程的效率工具，或用於自身媒體聯繫與新聞稿撰寫，降低人工成本。
items.why_en: Agencies can evaluate Honeyjar to streamline client PR workflows — from press release drafting to journalist matching — and reduce time spent on routine media outreach tasks.
highlights: Honeyjar 提供 AI 驅動的新聞稿撰寫、媒體配對及發言機會搜尋，目標降低中小企業的公關成本門檻。
平台上線 24 小時內累積逾萬名候補用戶，Nextdoor、多家創業公司及非牟利機構已完成測試。
此工具挑戰 PR Newswire 等傳統媒介發布服務，以 AI 個性化匹配取代批量廣播模式。
highlights_en: Honeyjar offers AI-driven press release drafting, journalist matching, and speaking opportunity search, targeting to lower the PR cost barrier for mid-market and small businesses.
The platform attracted over 10,000 waitlist signups within 24 hours of launch, with beta testers including Nextdoor and various startups and nonprofits.
The tool challenges traditional wire services like PR Newswire by replacing mass-broadcast distribution with AI-personalized journalist matching.
items.detail:
Honeyjar 由兩位擁有深厚公關與傳播背景的創辦人共同創立：CEO Michelle Masek 曾任 Obvious Ventures 行銷與傳播資深副總裁，CCO Nadia Jamshidi 則在代理商與企業端累積了數十年的公關實務經驗。兩人將平台定位於一個長期被忽視的痛點：企業內部存在大量「無頭銜的傳播者」——創辦人、行銷人員、投資者、作者及創作者——他們實際承擔著對外溝通的職責，卻沒有專業公關支援，只能仰賴個人判斷摸索。Honeyjar 的設計目標是把資深公關顧問的判斷力內化到 AI 流程之中，替這群人補足缺口。

平台核心功能涵蓋四個環節：自動撰寫新聞稿與公告、比對媒體資料庫為客戶尋找最相關的記者進行精準 Pitch、追蹤既有報導曝光狀況，以及主動發掘符合客戶專長的演講與受訪機會。與市面上部分工具不同，Honeyjar 明確強調「人在環路」——AI 負責起草內容，最終發送或發布的決定仍由用戶掌握。Masek 將平台的運作原則描述為整合「訊號、情境、策略、判斷、時機與執行」，強調公關效果依賴的不只是文字生成，而是對時機與優先序的系統性把握。

平台開放候補名單後，24 小時內累積逾萬名登記者，反映市場對自動化傳播工具的強烈需求。已參與測試的機構包括社群平台 Nextdoor、機器人新創 Coco Robotics、創投機構 Bloomberg Beta，以及公關代理商 Mission North 與 Full Picture，涵蓋科技、創投與傳統 PR 服務等不同垂直領域。多元的早期測試群體也顯示創辦人有意驗證：Honeyjar 能否在規模差異懸殊的組織中，同樣發揮穩定效用。

Honeyjar 以參展 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 作為正式亮相舞台，這一選擇本身即具備傳播意涵——在科技媒體最集中的活動上首次曝光，既是對平台定位的詮釋，也是對早期用戶群的測試。目前創辦人尚未公開融資金額與定價資訊，意味著平台仍處於以候補名單積累需求訊號的階段。對行銷與公關行業而言，Honeyjar 最值得關注之處，在於它嘗試將「戰略判斷力」而非僅「文字生產力」編碼進 AI 系統，若能兌現這一承諾，將對代理商的傳統附加值定義構成真正的結構性挑戰。
items.detail_en:
Honeyjar was co-founded by two practitioners with deep public relations and communications backgrounds: CEO Michelle Masek, former SVP of marketing and communications at Obvious Ventures, and CCO Nadia Jamshidi, who brings decades of agency and in-house PR experience. The founders built the platform around a persistently underserved pain point: companies contain large numbers of what Masek calls "unassigned communicators" — founders, marketers, investors, authors, and creators — who carry real communications responsibilities without professional PR support, relying on personal judgment to navigate outreach. Honeyjar's design goal is to encode senior-level PR judgment into AI workflows and close that gap.

The platform's core functionality spans four areas: automated drafting of press releases and announcements; journalist matching that cross-references a media database to identify the most relevant contacts for a given pitch; coverage tracking; and proactive identification of speaking and interview opportunities aligned with the client's expertise. Unlike some generative tools, Honeyjar explicitly keeps humans in the loop — the AI drafts, but the user decides whether to send or publish. Masek describes the platform's operating principle as integrating "signals, context, strategy, judgment, timing, and execution," emphasizing that PR effectiveness depends not just on copy generation but on systematic prioritization of what to say and when.

Within 24 hours of opening its waitlist, Honeyjar accumulated more than 10,000 signups, signaling strong latent demand for automated communications tools. Early beta participants include Nextdoor, robotics startup Coco Robotics, Bloomberg Beta, and PR agencies Mission North and Full Picture — spanning social platforms, deep tech, venture capital, and traditional PR services. The diversity of early testers suggests the founders are deliberately stress-testing whether Honeyjar delivers consistent value across organizations of very different scales.

Honeyjar chose TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 as its public debut stage — a choice that is itself a communications strategy, surfacing the platform in front of the densest concentration of technology media at once. Funding amounts and pricing have not been disclosed, indicating the platform remains in a demand-signal phase. For the marketing and PR industry, the most significant question Honeyjar raises is whether it can genuinely encode strategic judgment — not just writing productivity — into an AI system. If it delivers on that promise, it poses a structural challenge to the traditional value proposition of communications agencies.

items.title: Ambi 完成 2,600 萬美元融資，推出全程環境監聽 AI 助理
items.title_en: Ambi Raises $26M for Ambient AI Assistant That Listens in the Background
items.summary: Ambi 完成 2,600 萬美元融資，其 iOS、Mac 及 Apple Watch 應用持續環境錄音，於會議中主動提供 AI 建議，整合日曆與知識庫，環境錄音預設關閉，並計劃推出獨立硬體。
items.summary_en: Ambi raised $26M to build an ambient AI assistant that listens in the background on iPhone, Mac, and Apple Watch, proactively surfacing meeting insights using calendar data and knowledge bases, with ambient capture off by default and a hardware device planned.
items.why: 常態監聽 AI 工具於代理商客戶簡報及會議場景具應用潛力，同時引發數據採集與私隱合規問題，使用前需評估風險。
items.why_en: Ambient AI recording tools offer potential for agency meeting workflows, but raise data consent and privacy compliance questions that must be assessed before deployment in client-facing contexts.
highlights: Ambi 獲 Luminous Ventures 等機構領投共 2,600 萬美元，應用可在 iPhone、Mac 及 Apple Watch 上持續環境錄音。
平台主動結合日曆、知識庫與實時對話，在會議中提供相關背景建議，環境錄音功能預設關閉以保護私隱。
創辦人為前 Plaud 高管，團隊橫跨三藩市與中國，並計劃推出配備螢幕與鏡頭的獨立硬體設備。
highlights_en: Ambi raised $26M led by Luminous Ventures, offering continuous ambient recording across iPhone, Mac, and Apple Watch.
The app proactively surfaces context from calendars and knowledge bases during meetings; ambient recording is off by default to protect privacy.
Founded by a former Plaud executive, with teams across San Francisco and China, and a dedicated hardware device with screen and camera planned.
items.detail:
Ambi 本輪融資由 Luminous Ventures 主導，該基金過往曾投資美團與宇樹機器人；共同領投方為 ODM 製造商華勤技術（Huaqin），後者的加入除資金支持外，亦預示 Ambi 在自有硬體開發上的潛在製造優勢。公司目前在舊金山、北京、上海與深圳設有辦公室，員工逾 50 人，正積極招募負責市場拓展及 AI 語音辨識工程的人才。創辦人兼 CEO Peter Mo 此前任職於 Plaud，後者是一家以 AI 會議錄音硬體起家的公司，他對環境音訊處理與用戶隱私取捨的理解，直接形塑了 Ambi 的產品哲學。

Ambi 的核心設計理念是「全程情境感知」：應用程式在用戶授權後持續收集環境音訊，並在跨裝置環境——iPhone、Mac 與 Apple Watch——之間無縫同步上下文。在會議進行中，系統能主動調取日曆、用戶自建的知識庫，以及即時網路資料，在無需用戶發出指令的情況下，主動推送相關建議或背景資訊。即將推出的桌面端則進一步擴充功能邊界：除麥克風輸入外，系統將同時監測螢幕活動，並將日常工作內容轉化為可呼叫的個人化知識庫，使 AI 建議愈用愈貼合個人工作模式。

環境錄音預設關閉，用戶須主動啟用；停用時 Ambi 退回為一般 AI 助理模式。公司聲稱錄音不會儲存在其伺服器，資料全程加密，Mo 本人亦坦承：「我們作為一個行業，在如何讓用戶知道自己被錄音這個問題上，尚未找到答案。」這一誠實的表態在技術界引發不同反應，部分人視為負責任的自我揭示，另一些人則認為這恰恰說明法規框架尚未跟上產品設計的速度。獨立硬體裝置計劃配備螢幕、揚聲器、鏡頭與麥克風陣列，針對辦公室與會議室場景設計，旨在提供比手機更低干擾的環境感知體驗。

對行銷與廣告業而言，Ambi 代表著一類新型數據基礎設施的雛形：AI 系統從被動的查詢響應者，轉變為主動的情境監測者，持續在後台積累關於用戶偏好、決策語境與工作節奏的細粒度信號。若這類技術在企業端普及，其生成的個人化知識圖譜理論上可成為廣告定向與內容個性化的新維度——同時也意味著現行以 Cookie 或設備 ID 為核心的追蹤框架，將面臨更底層的架構性替代。
items.detail_en:
Ambi's funding round was led by Luminous Ventures — backers of Meituan and Unitree Robotics — with ODM manufacturer Huaqin co-leading. Huaqin's participation signals not just capital but potential manufacturing capacity for the company's planned standalone hardware. Ambi currently employs more than 50 people across San Francisco, Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, and is actively hiring in go-to-market and AI speech recognition engineering. Founder and CEO Peter Mo previously worked at Plaud, an AI meeting-recorder hardware company, and his experience navigating the tension between ambient audio processing and user privacy directly shapes Ambi's product philosophy.

Ambi's core design principle is persistent contextual awareness: with user permission, the app continuously captures ambient audio and syncs context seamlessly across iPhone, Mac, and Apple Watch. During meetings, the system draws on the user's calendar, a self-built knowledge base, and live web data to surface relevant suggestions proactively — without requiring the user to issue a query. The forthcoming desktop app expands this further: in addition to microphone input, it will monitor screen activity and convert daily work into a personalized knowledge base that AI suggestions can draw on, making recommendations more tailored the more it is used.

Ambient listening is disabled by default; users must actively enable it, and when disabled the app functions as a conventional AI assistant. The company states that recordings are not stored on its servers and that data is fully encrypted. Mo acknowledged directly: "We, as an industry, haven't solved the problem of disclosure" — how to ensure people in the room know they are being recorded. That candor drew mixed reactions: some read it as responsible transparency, others as evidence that regulatory frameworks have not kept pace with product design. The planned standalone hardware device, equipped with a screen, speaker, camera, and microphone array, is designed for office and meeting-room contexts to deliver ambient awareness with less interruption than a mobile phone.

For the marketing and advertising industry, Ambi represents an early form of a new data infrastructure category: AI systems shifting from passive query-responders to active context monitors that continuously accumulate fine-grained signals about user preferences, decision contexts, and work rhythms. If this technology achieves enterprise adoption, the personalized knowledge graphs it generates could become a new dimension for ad targeting and content personalization — while also suggesting that the current tracking architecture centered on cookies and device IDs faces a deeper structural replacement from below.

items.title: IAB 香港副主席：代理商應將 AI 省下的成本投入原創 IP，而非只求降費
items.title_en: HK Agencies Must Reinvest AI Cost Savings into Fresh IP, Not Just Capture Efficiencies, Says IAB
items.summary: IAB 香港副主席 Arthur Chan 指出，AI 已大幅降低跨市場測試成本，惟業界更大機遇在於將省下的資源重新投入原創 IP 與體驗創作，而非單純以降費作為賣點。
items.summary_en: IAB Hong Kong Vice Chair Arthur Chan argued AI is significantly cutting cross-market testing costs but warned agencies that the real growth opportunity lies in reinvesting those savings into original IP and experiences — not just using AI as a cost-cutting pitch.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 直接針對香港代理商的 AI 策略建議，點出「效率提升」以外的差異化增長路徑，對重新定位 AI 服務主張具參考價值。
items.why_en: Directly addresses HK ad agency AI strategy, offering a differentiated growth narrative beyond cost-cutting that agencies can use to reframe their AI value proposition to clients.
highlights: IAB 香港副主席 Arthur Chan 指出，AI 已大幅壓低跨市場廣告測試的成本門檻，中小品牌亦可負擔多市場同步測試。
Chan 警告代理商不應將「AI 省錢」作為唯一賣點，省下的資源應重新投入開發原創 IP 與沉浸式體驗，創造更難被複製的競爭優勢。
此論點反映業界對「AI 商品化」的憂慮：當所有代理商都能用 AI 降費時，策略創意能力才是真正的護城河。
highlights_en: IAB Hong Kong Vice Chair Arthur Chan noted AI has dramatically lowered the cost threshold for cross-market campaign testing, making multi-market experimentation accessible to mid-size brands.
Chan warned agencies against positioning 'AI saves money' as their only selling point — savings should be reinvested in original IP and immersive experiences that are harder to replicate.
The argument reflects industry-wide concern about AI commoditization: when every agency can cut costs with AI, strategic creative capability becomes the real competitive moat.
items.detail:
Arthur Chan 的論點根植於一個結構性觀察：AI 壓低了跨市場創意測試的邊際成本。過去，一家代理商若要在東南亞三個市場同時測試五套創意方向，光是製作成本便已形成實質門檻；如今 AI 生成工具大幅縮短週期、削減人力，令「多市場、小批量、快速迭代」的測試模式在財務上成為可行。這一成本重心的位移，是 Chan 論述的前提——他不否認降費帶來的競爭壓力，而是指出這個前提本身開啟了一扇此前關閉的門。

 Chan 主張，代理商若只將 AI 效率紅利轉化為向客戶報價更低的籌碼，等同於選擇了一條加速商品化的路徑：競爭者同樣擁有相同工具，價格戰的終點是整個行業的利潤率收縮。他提出的替代方向是將節省下來的資源——時間、人力與預算——重新投入原創 IP 與體驗設計，開拓「人們願意付費」的新收入形態。這一轉向的實質是業務模式的重組：從以執行時數計費，轉向以版權授權、IP 合作或品牌體驗策劃等形式獲取更高單價的回報。

香港代理商市場面臨的結構性處境，賦予這一論點額外的現實壓力。香港市場規模有限，客戶本地預算普遍低於區域市場同業，代理商若以執行效率作為主要競爭維度，空間本就逼仄；加之 AI 工具的普及令執行層面的技術門檻持續降低，本地代理商在純執行層面難以形成可持續的差異化護城河。Chan 的視角隱含著對香港代理商定位的判斷：本地市場的長期競爭優勢，更可能來自文化洞察力、創意版權積累與客戶關係深度，而非速度或報價。

IAB 香港副主席的身份，令這番論點在機構層面具備一定代表性。IAB 作為數位廣告產業協會，其立場傳統上較傾向推動技術採用與市場規範，Chan 在這一場合強調原創 IP 而非工具效率，可解讀為對行業整體方向的一次公開校準——在 AI 工具普及的初期，在代理商集體面對降費壓力的時間節點，明確主張保留「人類創意判斷力」作為不可外包的核心資產。
items.detail_en:
Arthur Chan's argument rests on a structural observation: AI has reduced the marginal cost of testing creative across markets. Previously, running five creative directions simultaneously across three Southeast Asian markets carried a production cost that posed a real threshold. AI generation tools have compressed timelines and cut headcount requirements, making multi-market, small-batch, rapid-iteration testing financially viable for the first time. This shift in the cost center is the premise of Chan's argument — he does not dispute the competitive pressure of lower fees but contends that the premise itself opens a door that was previously closed.

Chan argues that if agencies convert AI efficiency gains solely into lower quotes for clients, they are choosing a path of accelerating commoditization. Competitors have access to the same tools, and a price war ends in industry-wide margin compression. His alternative is to reinvest the savings — time, personnel, and budget — into original IP and experience design, cultivating new revenue forms that audiences or brands will pay a premium for. The practical implication is a business model restructuring: shifting from billing for execution hours to capturing higher unit value through licensing, IP partnerships, or branded experience consulting.

The structural conditions of the Hong Kong agency market add particular urgency to this argument. With a limited local market and client budgets generally lower than regional peers, agencies competing primarily on execution efficiency have little room to maneuver. As AI tools lower the technical barriers to execution, Hong Kong agencies face diminishing prospects for sustainable differentiation at the production layer. Chan's framing implies a judgment about local positioning: the durable competitive advantage of Hong Kong agencies more likely lies in cultural insight, accumulated creative IP, and relationship depth than in speed or price.

Chan's role as IAB Hong Kong vice chair gives this position a degree of institutional weight. The IAB has traditionally emphasized technology adoption and market standards; for Chan to foreground original IP over tool efficiency at this juncture reads as a deliberate public recalibration — asserting, at the moment AI tools are becoming ubiquitous and agencies face collective pressure to cut fees, that human creative judgment remains the non-outsourceable core asset.

items.title: Stagwell 整合旗下媒體業務，Assembly 品牌正式停用
items.title_en: Stagwell Consolidates Media Assets Under New Stagwell Media Brand, Retiring Assembly
items.summary: Stagwell 宣布整合旗下媒體代理資產，成立 Stagwell Media，終止 Assembly 品牌，由 Assembly Global 行政總裁 Liz Rutgersson 領導新架構，標誌獨立代理商集團的整合加速。
items.summary_en: Stagwell consolidated its media agency assets under a new Stagwell Media brand, retiring the Assembly name, with Assembly Global CEO Liz Rutgersson leading the combined entity — marking an acceleration of consolidation among independent agency holding groups.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 獨立代理商集團整合加速，反映全球媒體購買市場格局正在重塑，對評估競爭格局及客戶服務模式有參考價值。
items.why_en: Independent holding group consolidation reshapes the global media-buying landscape, signaling competitive shifts relevant to agency positioning, client retention strategies, and pitch dynamics.
highlights: Stagwell 宣布整合旗下媒體代理資產，以 Stagwell Media 為統一品牌，正式停用 Assembly 品牌名稱。
Assembly Global 行政總裁 Liz Rutgersson 將領導整合後的新架構，維持現有客戶關係與業務連續性。
此舉反映獨立代理商集團面臨整合壓力，以增強對大型廣告主的談判力與規模效益。
highlights_en: Stagwell consolidated its media agency assets under a unified Stagwell Media brand, officially retiring the Assembly name.
Assembly Global CEO Liz Rutgersson will lead the merged entity, maintaining existing client relationships and business continuity.
The move reflects consolidation pressure on independent holding groups seeking greater scale and negotiating leverage with major advertisers.
items.followup: 10 月 7 日我們報過 Stagwell 以代理式 AI 平台 Machine OS 重組 Assembly，在 50 個市場推出 Stagwell Media 品牌。今日 Assembly 品牌正式停用，以 Stagwell Media 統一取代，由 Assembly Global 行政總裁 Liz Rutgersson 領導整合架構——從「重組」推進至「正式改名」，整合過渡期完成。
items.followup_en: On October 7 we reported Stagwell restructuring Assembly around its agentic AI platform Machine OS, launching Stagwell Media across 50 markets. Today Assembly is officially retired as a brand — unified under Stagwell Media with Liz Rutgersson leading the combined entity, completing the transition from 'restructuring' to 'completed rebrand.'
items.detail:
Stagwell 於 2026 年 10 月 6 日宣布成立全新全球媒體代理公司 Stagwell Media，以此取代旗下原有的 Assembly 品牌，終止後者作為獨立品牌的運作。Stagwell Media 並非單純的改名動作，而是定位為一個根本性的新模式：整合旗下原有媒體代理資產，並以技術驅動能力為核心重新架構整體服務體系。集團主席兼行政總裁 Mark Penn 明確指出，傳統媒體代理的運作模式並非為未來而建，市場對更高速度、更靈活應變能力以及更強智能的需求，形成一個清晰的結構性缺口，而 Stagwell Media 正是為填補此缺口而設計。

新架構由 Assembly Global 前行政總裁 Liz Rutgersson 出任 Stagwell Media 全球及美國行政總裁，統領整體業務方向。各地區設有獨立行政總裁，涵蓋亞太區的 Connie Chan、歐洲的 Bridget Hopkins、印度的 Alap Ghosh、中東及北非的 Ravi Rao，以及主理全球數字商務的 Kacper Klos。整個網絡橫跨逾 50 個市場，匯集超過 2,300 名業務人員，現有核心客戶包括聯想、DP World、萬事達卡及寶鹼。這一跨地區的分散式領導結構，顯示 Stagwell 有意以在地化的高層人才配置回應不同市場的複雜需求，而非以單一中心化模式管理全球業務。

Stagwell Media 在技術架構上以 Machine OS 為核心，這是集團自家開發的下一代智能代理技術平台，配合 The Media Machine、Stagwell Search+ 及 Stagwell Curate 等專有工具，形成完整的技術生態。集團同時宣佈旗下多個姊妹公司將作為合作夥伴協同運作，包括 Crispin、GALE、Goodstuff、Locaria 及 Stagwell 自有媒體部門，以打通創意、媒體與技術之間的服務邊界。新架構並引入以客戶成果為導向的商業定價模式，而非沿用傳統基於投放量的費率結構，反映獨立代理商集團在業務模式上的主動轉型。

此次整合發布，標誌著獨立代理商集團在應對 WPP、Publicis 等傳統控股集團的規模競爭時，選擇以技術整合與敏捷架構作為差異化路徑。Stagwell 通過捨棄 Assembly 這個已在市場上建立一定認知度的品牌，將集團名稱直接植入旗下核心媒體業務，意圖強化 Stagwell 作為整體技術驅動媒體集團的市場識別。在全球廣告市場加速向程序化、人工智能優化及代理式媒體購買轉型的背景下，此舉亦被視為獨立代理商集團宣示自身技術競爭力的信號。
items.detail_en:
Stagwell announced the launch of Stagwell Media on October 6, 2026, replacing its existing Assembly brand and ending the latter's operation as a standalone identity. The move is not a simple rebrand: the company has positioned Stagwell Media as a fundamentally new model that consolidates its media agency assets and rebuilds the service architecture around technology-driven capabilities. Chairman and CEO Mark Penn stated that the traditional media agency model was not built for the future, citing a clear structural gap in the market for greater speed, flexibility, and intelligence — a gap Stagwell Media is designed to fill.

Liz Rutgersson, previously CEO of Assembly Global, has been appointed CEO of Stagwell Media with both global and US remit. Regional chief executives lead individual markets: Connie Chan covers APAC, Bridget Hopkins leads Europe, Alap Ghosh heads India, Ravi Rao oversees MENA, and Kacper Klos serves as global CEO of Digital Commerce. The network spans more than 50 markets with over 2,300 specialists, serving clients including Lenovo, DP World, Mastercard, and P&G. The decentralized regional leadership structure signals Stagwell's intention to address local market complexity with senior on-the-ground talent rather than a single centralized operating model.

Technologically, Stagwell Media is anchored by Machine OS, the group's proprietary next-generation agentic technology platform, complemented by The Media Machine, Stagwell Search+, and Stagwell Curate. Several sister companies — Crispin, GALE, Goodstuff, Locaria, and Stagwell Owned Media — will operate as integrated partners, dissolving the traditional boundaries between creative, media, and technology services. The new commercial structure moves toward outcome-based pricing rather than the traditional volume-based fee model, reflecting a deliberate shift in how independent agency groups compete.

The consolidation signals a broader strategic choice by independent agency groups competing against WPP, Publicis, and Interpublic on scale: rather than matching headcount, Stagwell is betting on technology integration and agile architecture as its differentiation. By retiring the Assembly brand and placing the Stagwell name directly on its core media business, the group is reinforcing its identity as a technology-driven media enterprise. Against a backdrop of accelerating shifts toward programmatic buying, AI-optimized media, and agentic activation, the move is widely read as an independent group staking a claim to technical credibility alongside the holding-company incumbents.

items.title: SPH Media 聯同星和推出首個品牌微短劇，AI 特效呈現本地鬼故事
items.title_en: SPH Media Launches First Branded Microdrama with Singtel, Using AI Visual Effects
items.summary: SPH Media 與星和合作推出 24 集恐怖喜劇微短劇《CONNECTED》，採用 AI 輔助特效呈現本地民間傳說，以觸及率與自發分享衡量成效，標誌新加坡媒體集團進入 AI 輔助短劇製作。
items.summary_en: SPH Media partnered with Singtel to produce CONNECTED, a 24-episode horror-comedy microdrama using AI-assisted visual effects and Singapore folklore, measuring success by reach and organic sharing rather than direct sales, marking SPH's entry into AI-assisted short-drama production.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 微短劇加 AI 製作的品牌贊助模式在亞洲興起，對規劃影片內容策略及新格式廣告方案的 HK 代理商具直接參考價值。
items.why_en: AI-assisted branded microdrama is gaining traction as a format in Asia; directly informs HK agencies advising clients on short-video content strategy and branded entertainment sponsorship structures.
highlights: SPH Media 旗下 Content Lab 與星和合作推出 24 集微短劇《CONNECTED》，以本地鬼故事為題，採用 AI 輔助視覺特效呈現恐怖場景。
星和以品牌整合形式贊助，以觸及率與自發分享率（非直接轉化）為核心成效指標，體現微短劇廣告的品牌建設導向。
此案標誌新加坡主流媒體集團正式以 AI 輔助製作切入短劇賽道，或將帶動亞太其他市場跟進。
highlights_en: SPH Media's Content Lab partnered with Singtel to produce CONNECTED, a 24-episode horror-comedy microdrama using AI-assisted visual effects to portray Singapore folklore.
Singtel sponsored with brand integration, measuring success by reach and organic sharing rather than direct conversion — reflecting short drama advertising's brand-building orientation.
The case marks a Singapore major media group's formal entry into AI-assisted short-drama production, potentially influencing other Asia-Pacific markets to follow.
items.detail:
SPH Media 於 2026 年 10 月 10 日正式推出微短劇《CONNECTED》，這是該媒體集團首個自主開發的微短劇知識產權（IP），共 24 集，以恐怖喜劇為類型定位，由旗下 SPH Content Lab 製作團隊主導開發。首個合作贊助商為星和（Singtel），以「初登贊助商」（maiden sponsor）身份全程介入，令此次發布同時標誌著新加坡媒體集團在品牌內容格式上的一次重要拓展。劇集內容取材自 STOMP 用戶投稿的鬼故事，以及在新加坡渡假村、學校夜會等本土場景流傳的民間恐怖傳說，並跟隨兩名調查員在真實可辨識的新加坡地標探索超自然事件，把本地文化記憶嵌入敘事核心。

在製作技術上，《CONNECTED》採用混合視覺特效方案：劇中超自然生物先由 SPH Content Lab 藝術師手繪原創草圖，再結合原創攝影與實拍片段，透過混合特效技術完成後期製作。製作合作夥伴為 Editlounge 及 Gengis AI，後者主要負責 AI 生成特效環節。星和在詮釋這一製作方式時，以「人工智能結合人類智能與文化智能」描述其技術觀，強調 AI 特效並非單純的技術炫示，而是服務於在地文化表達的工具。

劇集透過三批次內容形式分批發布，分發渠道涵蓋 STOMP、HardwareZone 及星和旗下社交媒體頻道，令品牌曝光不局限於單一平台，同時借助 SPH Media 旗下已建立受眾基礎的媒體資產觸及不同用戶群體。星和在成效衡量上採用觸及率、觀看量、受眾互動、品牌影響力，以及觀眾是否主動分享等指標，而非傳統點擊轉化模型，反映微短劇在品牌整合行銷上的成效邏輯有別於一般數字廣告。SPH Media 方面表示，未來不打算將微短劇設為標準化內容方案，而是視客戶目標決定是否採用此格式，以配合內容與商業目標的高度對齊。

此次合作項目對 SPH Media 而言，是 SPH Content Lab 在動畫防詐騙內容、寬頻喜劇及中小企業改造實境節目等既有格式以外，首次正式進入微短劇賽道。對星和而言，「保持人與人之間連繫」這一品牌主題被有機融入劇情架構，令品牌形象與劇集敘事相輔相成，超越了傳統贊助的植入邏輯。雙方均表示，後續是否深化合作，將取決於受眾的實際反應，說明此次項目同時具備商業探索與市場測試的雙重性質，也折射出本地媒體生態在 AI 輔助製作成本下降後，短劇 IP 商業化路徑的加速演進。
items.detail_en:
SPH Media launched its first original microdrama IP, CONNECTED, on October 10, 2026. The 24-episode horror-comedy series was developed by SPH Content Lab and features Singtel as its maiden sponsor, marking the Singapore media group's formal entry into AI-assisted short drama production. The series draws its narrative material from ghost stories submitted by STOMP users and tales shared at chalets, school camps, and local social gatherings, following two investigators exploring supernatural occurrences at recognizable Singapore locations. Rooting the content in locally familiar settings and folklore places cultural memory at the center of the storytelling rather than treating it as a backdrop.

Production uses a hybrid visual effects approach: supernatural creatures were first hand-sketched by SPH Content Lab artists, then integrated with original photography and live-action footage through composite effects. Production partners are Editlounge and Gengis AI, the latter handling AI-generated effects. Singtel framed this methodology as combining artificial intelligence with human intelligence and cultural intelligence — positioning AI effects not as a technical showcase but as a tool in service of local cultural expression.

The series is distributed in three content drops across STOMP, HardwareZone, and Singtel's social media channels, extending brand exposure beyond a single platform and leveraging SPH Media's existing audience assets across different demographic segments. Singtel's measurement framework covers reach, viewership, audience engagement, brand impact, and organic sharing behavior — a metrics set that differs significantly from standard digital advertising conversion models and reflects the distinct performance logic of brand-integrated content. SPH Media has stated it does not intend to standardize microdramas as a default content solution, preferring to match format to each client's specific objectives.

For SPH Media, the project represents SPH Content Lab's first entry into the microdrama format, extending beyond its existing repertoire of animated scam-awareness content, broadband comedy, and SME makeover formats. For Singtel, the brand's core message of keeping people connected has been woven organically into the drama's narrative structure, moving beyond conventional sponsorship placement logic. Both parties have indicated that further collaboration will depend on audience response, confirming that this launch carries dual purposes: commercial activation and market validation. It also reflects the broader acceleration in local media ecosystems as AI-assisted production lowers the cost threshold for original short-form IP development.

items.title: 百事可樂印度 CMO：品牌關聯性是移動靶，預判文化比追趕文化更重要
items.title_en: PepsiCo India's CMO: Brand Relevance Is a Moving Target — Anticipate Culture, Don't Chase It
items.summary: 百事可樂印度 CMO Saakshi Verma Menon 指出，規模已非競爭優勢，數據敏捷度與文化智能才是維持品牌關聯性的核心，強調印度是眾多市場的集合而非單一受眾。
items.summary_en: PepsiCo India CMO Saakshi Verma Menon argued that scale is no longer sufficient as a competitive advantage, emphasizing data agility and cultural intelligence — not just reach — as the core of brand relevance across fragmented consumer markets.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 亞太大品牌 CMO 以「文化智能取代規模優先」為論述，對 HK 代理商重新定位數據驅動策略的價值主張具直接啟示。
items.why_en: A major APAC brand CMO's framing of cultural intelligence over scale directly informs how HK agencies should position data-driven strategy in new business pitches and client strategy reviews.
highlights: 百事可樂印度 CMO 指出，規模已非足夠的競爭優勢，數據敏捷度與文化智能才是維持品牌關聯性的核心。
她強調印度市場是眾多不同受眾群體的集合，品牌必須以細分市場為單位制定策略，而非以全國市場思維統一處理。
「預判文化」而非「追趕文化」的論述，意味數據工具的價值在於預測文化轉向，而非事後回應已成形的趨勢。
highlights_en: PepsiCo India's CMO argued scale is no longer sufficient as a competitive moat — data agility and cultural intelligence are now the core of sustained brand relevance.
She framed India as a collection of distinct audience groups requiring market-by-market strategy, not a unified national-market approach.
The 'anticipate culture, don't chase it' thesis positions data tools as instruments for predicting cultural shifts, not just reacting to trends after they emerge.
items.detail:
百事可樂印度 CMO Saakshi Verma Menon 以「移動靶」形容品牌關聯性的本質，點出一個在快速變動的消費市場中越來越難以迴避的現實：品牌過去依賴規模優勢建立的市場地位，如今已無法作為長期競爭壁壘。她明確指出，規模本身已不再是優勢，真正能維持關聯性的核心條件，是數據能力、組織敏捷度，以及對文化脈絡的深度理解，三者缺一難以為繼。

她對印度市場的結構性描述具有實質意義。她將印度定性為「許多個印度的集合」，而非可以用一套受眾邏輯統一覆蓋的單一市場。這一判斷在品牌操盤層面有直接的運營含義：語言多元、宗教節慶週期各異、城鄉消費場景差距懸殊，令任何試圖以單一全國性創意概念觸動整體受眾的策略，都面臨系統性失效的風險。對百事可樂這樣深度依賴年輕消費者群體的品牌而言，文化洞察的在地顆粒度直接決定內容是否能夠真正引發共鳴，而非僅僅獲得曝光。

Verma Menon 提出的「預判文化」框架，與通常意義上的趨勢追蹤有本質區別。追趕文化往往意味著品牌在一個話題已達到廣泛認知後才行動，此時進入的邊際效益遞減。她強調的是在話題尚未成為主流之前，透過數據信號識別正在形成中的文化動向，提前在品牌層面卡位，從而在話題爆發時獲得先發者的聲量優勢。這需要品牌在數據基礎建設與文化感知之間建立持續的協作機制，而非依賴週期性的消費者研究或年度品牌策略更新。

在當前全球快消品牌普遍面臨增長壓力的背景下，Verma Menon 的論述呼應了一個更宏觀的行業討論：廣告投入的回報率如何隨著市場碎片化而結構性下降，以及品牌如何透過更精準的文化定位而非更大的媒體預算來維持競爭力。她的核心立場是，速度與文化智能的組合，才是下一個競爭週期中品牌真正可持續的護城河，而非傳統意義上的媒體購買規模或分銷網絡覆蓋。
items.detail_en:
PepsiCo India CMO Saakshi Verma Menon uses the phrase 'moving target' to describe brand relevance, surfacing a reality that is increasingly difficult to avoid in fast-changing consumer markets: the scale advantages that once anchored brand leadership can no longer serve as a durable competitive moat. She is explicit that scale alone is no longer an advantage, and that the genuine drivers of sustained relevance are data capability, organizational agility, and cultural intelligence — each necessary, none sufficient on its own.

Her structural characterization of India carries direct operational weight. She describes India not as a single addressable market but as a collection of many Indias, meaning that any brand strategy built on a unified national audience logic faces systemic failure risk. Linguistic diversity, distinct regional festival calendars, and the wide gap between urban and rural consumption contexts mean that creative concepts that resonate in one geography can feel foreign or tone-deaf in another. For a brand like PepsiCo that relies heavily on youth consumer cohorts, the granularity of local cultural insight directly determines whether content generates genuine resonance or only exposure.

The framework Verma Menon proposes — anticipating culture rather than chasing it — differs from conventional trend-tracking in a fundamental way. Chasing a trend typically means a brand activates after a topic has achieved mainstream recognition, at which point the incremental value of participation diminishes rapidly. Her approach involves identifying emerging cultural signals before they reach broad awareness, enabling the brand to establish a presence at the formation stage and capture first-mover share of voice when the trend peaks. Operationalizing this requires an ongoing feedback loop between data infrastructure and cultural sensing, rather than dependence on periodic consumer research or annual brand strategy cycles.

Against a backdrop of structural growth pressure on global FMCG brands, Verma Menon's argument connects to a broader industry debate: how advertising return on investment declines structurally as media fragments, and how brands can sustain competitive positioning through sharper cultural targeting rather than larger media budgets. Her core position is that the combination of speed and cultural intelligence represents the genuinely durable competitive advantage in the next competitive cycle — superseding the traditional metrics of media buying scale and distribution network reach.

items.title: 黃金週人潮創新高，消費者每程開支跌至四年最低
items.title_en: China's Golden Week Brought Record Crowds but Spending per Trip Hit a Four-Year Low
items.summary: 中國十一黃金週出行人數強勁，惟每程消費額跌至四年低位，消費者出行意願與消費意願的剪刀差持續擴大，中國市場信心復甦訊號仍未明確。
items.summary_en: China's National Day Golden Week saw strong travel volume but average spending per trip fell to a four-year low, widening the gap between travel intent and consumption confidence and leaving a mixed signal for China market recovery.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 黃金週消費數據直接影響代理商對中國客戶 Q4 大促策略的調整建議，消費信心下滑需納入創意與媒體計劃修訂。
items.why_en: Golden Week spending data directly informs agencies' Q4 strategy recommendations for China-facing clients; declining consumption confidence should be factored into creative and media plan revisions.
highlights: 中國十一黃金週出行人次錄得強勁增長，惟每程平均消費額跌至近四年最低，顯示消費者出行意欲與消費信心之間存在明顯落差。
「出行不消費」模式與 2023–2024 年的報復性消費期全然不同，反映消費者在旅遊體驗上維持支出，惟在非必要消費上持續縮減。
數據對依賴黃金週催谷銷售的品牌及代理商是警示信號，中國市場消費復甦的強度與預期存在差距。
highlights_en: China's National Day Golden Week recorded strong travel volume but average spending per trip fell to a near-four-year low, revealing a clear gap between travel intent and consumption confidence.
The 'travel without spending' pattern sharply diverges from the 2023–2024 revenge-spending era, with consumers maintaining experiential spending but continuing to cut discretionary purchases.
The data is a warning signal for brands and agencies relying on Golden Week to drive sales peaks, suggesting China's consumer recovery momentum is weaker than forecast.
items.detail:
2026 年中國十一黃金週七天長假呈現出一個結構性矛盾：出行人數錄得強勁表現，惟每程平均消費額跌至四年以來的最低水平。兩組數據同向疊加，在表面上構成「人多錢少」的剪刀差，折射的是消費者在出行意願與消費意願之間日益擴大的鴻溝。出行數字的上升，顯示壓抑已久的流動需求並未消退；每程消費的同步下跌，則暗示消費者在預算分配與消費場景選擇上，正在主動收縮。

這種消費行為的結構性轉變，與近年中國宏觀經濟環境直接相關。房地產市場的持續調整削減了大量中產家庭的資產性財富，令即時消費的心理基礎受到侵蝕。通縮壓力使得消費者預期未來物價持續下跌，從而推遲非必要支出的決策。在此背景下，黃金週的出行消費呈現出明顯的降級傾向：短途目的地取代遠程旅遊、平價住宿替換高端酒店、自由行替換跟團消費，令整體人均開支受壓。即便出行人數再創高峰，旅遊業實際收益的轉換效率已大幅下滑。

對品牌主而言，黃金週數據提示了一個需要重新校準的假設：人流並不等同於消費力，流量轉化為收益的鏈路比以往更長、更不確定。過往依賴旺季人潮自然帶動銷售的傳統商業邏輯，在此類「量升價跌」的消費環境下愈發失靈。這要求品牌在黃金週等節日大促的規劃中，更細緻地區分出行受眾與消費受眾，並圍繞「錢花在哪裡」而非「人去了哪裡」來設計觸達策略。

更宏觀而言，黃金週每程消費創四年新低，是中國消費市場信心修復訊號至今仍未明確的一個縮影。出行人數的強勁表現或反映政策引導與積壓需求的釋放，而非消費信心的實質回升。在企業廣告預算規劃及市場進入決策層面，這種「量強但質弱」的消費形態，意味著以黃金週數據作為整體市場復甦論據時，需要對人次與人均開支兩項指標分別獨立解讀，避免以出行規模掩蓋消費意願的結構性疲弱。
items.detail_en:
China's 2026 National Day Golden Week seven-day holiday produced a structural contradiction: travel volume recorded strong figures, while average spend per trip fell to its lowest level in four years. The two data points moving in opposite directions describe a widening scissors gap between willingness to travel and willingness to spend. Strong travel numbers confirm that pent-up mobility demand remains intact; the simultaneous drop in per-trip expenditure indicates that consumers are actively compressing their budget allocation and downgrading their spending choices across the trip lifecycle.

This structural shift in consumer behavior is directly connected to China's macroeconomic environment in recent years. Persistent adjustment in the property market has reduced the asset wealth of a large segment of middle-class households, weakening the psychological foundation for discretionary consumption. Deflationary pressure reinforces consumer expectations of further price declines, delaying non-essential spending decisions. Against this backdrop, Golden Week travel patterns show a clear downgrade trend: shorter-haul destinations replacing long-distance trips, budget accommodation substituting for premium hotels, independent travel replacing packaged tours. Even when headcount reaches record highs, the revenue conversion efficiency of tourism activity has declined substantially.

For brand marketers, the Golden Week data signals that a foundational assumption needs recalibrating: foot traffic is not equivalent to purchasing power, and the path from audience reach to actual revenue is longer and less certain than before. The traditional commercial logic that relies on holiday crowds to organically lift sales is increasingly ineffective in a consumption environment characterized by high volume and weak per-capita spend. This requires brands planning Golden Week and holiday campaigns to distinguish more precisely between travel audiences and spending audiences, and to design activation strategies around where money is being spent rather than where people are going.

At a broader level, per-trip spending falling to a four-year low during Golden Week is a symptom of the fact that confidence signals in China's consumer market have not yet clarified. Strong travel numbers may reflect policy incentives and the release of suppressed mobility demand rather than any genuine recovery in consumer confidence. For corporate advertising budget planning and market entry decisions, this pattern of strong volume but weak quality means that Golden Week figures should be read with travel headcount and per-capita expenditure treated as independent indicators — rather than allowing the scale of travel numbers to mask the structural softness of consumer willingness to spend.

items.title: Nike 銷售跌 26% 尋找阿迪達斯式復甦之道，分析師聚焦文化關聯性重建
items.title_en: Nike's China Sales Down 26% as Analysts Ask: Can It Stage an Adidas-Style Comeback?
items.summary: Nike 中國業務銷售年跌 26%，業界開始以阿迪達斯近年在華復甦為藍本，探討 Nike 能否透過文化關聯性重建及本土化策略逆轉跌勢，惟形勢較阿迪達斯案例更為嚴峻。
items.summary_en: Nike's China sales fell 26% year-over-year, prompting analysts to compare its path to Adidas's recent recovery in China, examining whether Nike can rebuild cultural relevance and reverse its decline through localization — though the situation is seen as more challenging.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 國際品牌在華文化關聯性失落的分析，對代理商協助全球客戶制定中國市場本土化策略具參考意義。
items.why_en: Analysis of how global brands lose and rebuild cultural relevance in China directly informs agencies advising international clients on China localization and brand health recovery strategies.
highlights: Nike 中國業務年跌 26%，引發業界廣泛討論其是否能複製阿迪達斯近年的在華復甦路徑。
阿迪達斯成功案例的核心在於重建與中國青年文化的情感連結，但分析師指 Nike 面臨的挑戰較當年阿迪更為複雜。
此案折射國際品牌在中國市場的結構性困境：政治、文化情緒與本土競品崛起三重壓力並存。
highlights_en: Nike's China sales fell 26% year-over-year, prompting industry discussion about whether it can replicate Adidas's recent recovery trajectory in the Chinese market.
Adidas's comeback was rooted in rebuilding emotional connection with Chinese youth culture, but analysts see Nike's challenge as significantly more complex.
The case reflects a structural tension facing international brands in China: geopolitical sentiment, cultural relevance gaps, and rising domestic competitors converging simultaneously.
items.detail:
Nike 中國業務在最新財季錄得銷售年跌 26%，創下近年最大單季跌幅之一，使品牌在全球最大運動市場之一的地位持續受壓。這一數字令業界開始認真討論：阿迪達斯過去數年在中國的復甦路徑，能否成為 Nike 的可借鑑藍本？

阿迪達斯在 2021 至 2022 年間同樣因新疆棉花事件遭受中國消費者強烈抵制，業績一度大幅滑落。其後，阿迪達斯採取主動重建文化關聯性的策略：推出中國獨家設計系列、與本土運動員及文化人物深度合作、加大在微信、抖音等本地平台的內容投入，並積極贊助本土體育賽事。這些措施在 2024 至 2025 年間逐步收效，令阿迪達斯的中國業務重拾正增長軌道，成為外資運動品牌在地重建的一個罕見成功案例。

Nike 所面對的挑戰，在若干維度上較阿迪達斯更為複雜。安踏、李寧等本土品牌在 Nike 業績低迷的幾年間大幅提升了產品設計力與品牌形象，在年輕消費族群中累積了相當厚度的文化認同，這種認同並非單靠廣告預算可以短期逆轉。分析師普遍指出，「文化關聯性」而非純粹的行銷聲量，才是決定外資品牌能否在中國重獲年輕消費者青睞的核心變數。

Nike 近期已在策略層面作出調整，包括強調「回歸產品本質」、重新聚焦創新款式研發，以及在球鞋文化社群中加強內容存在感。然而，業界觀察人士認為，從策略轉向到消費者認知改變之間，往往存在一段不可壓縮的時間落差。Nike 能否複製阿迪達斯的復甦節奏，仍取決於其本土化執行的深度與一致性，以及能否在競爭已更趨激烈的市場中，重新定義自身在中國消費者生活方式中的角色。
items.detail_en:
Nike's China business recorded a year-on-year sales decline of 26% in its latest fiscal quarter, marking one of the steepest single-quarter drops in recent years and continuing to erode the brand's standing in one of the world's largest sports markets. This figure has prompted serious industry discussion about whether Adidas's recovery trajectory in China over the past few years can serve as a viable blueprint for Nike.

Adidas faced similarly severe backlash from Chinese consumers following the Xinjiang cotton controversy of 2021-2022, with its business suffering sharp declines. The brand subsequently pursued a strategy of actively rebuilding cultural relevance: launching China-exclusive design collections, deepening partnerships with domestic athletes and cultural figures, increasing content investment on local platforms such as WeChat and Douyin, and sponsoring domestic sporting events. These measures gradually bore fruit in 2024-2025, returning Adidas's China business to positive growth and establishing it as a rare successful example of a foreign sportswear brand rebuilding its local presence.

The challenges Nike faces are more complex across several dimensions. Domestic brands such as Anta and Li-Ning significantly elevated their product design capabilities and brand equity during the years of Nike's underperformance, accumulating considerable cultural capital among younger consumer segments — a depth of identity that cannot easily be reversed through advertising spend alone. Analysts broadly argue that 'cultural relevance,' rather than sheer marketing volume, is the decisive variable in whether foreign brands can recapture the affection of young Chinese consumers.

Nike has recently made strategic adjustments, including an emphasis on 'returning to product fundamentals,' refocusing on innovative footwear development, and strengthening its content presence within sneaker culture communities. Industry observers note, however, that there is typically an irreducible time lag between strategic repositioning and meaningful shifts in consumer perception. Whether Nike can replicate Adidas's recovery pace ultimately depends on the depth and consistency of its localization execution, and on whether it can redefine its role in Chinese consumers' lifestyles within an even more competitive landscape than Adidas faced.

items.title: 阿迪達斯奪 F1 新加坡站社交聲量榜首，TikTok 為星航逆轉互動排名的關鍵
items.title_en: Adidas Tops F1 Singapore GP Social Voice, While Singapore Airlines Rides TikTok to Flip Engagement Rankings
items.summary: Meltwater 數據顯示，阿迪達斯以逾 9,400 次提及奪 2026 F1 新加坡站網路聲量第一；星加坡航空以 TikTok 佔比 75% 的互動逆轉排名，揭示聲量與互動之間的平台策略落差。
items.summary_en: Meltwater data shows Adidas led F1 Singapore GP 2026 sponsor mentions with 9,439, while Singapore Airlines drove 75% of its interactions via TikTok to climb the engagement rankings — highlighting how platform-specific strategy creates divergent results between mention volume and actual engagement.
items.why: 真實大型體育贊助數據的聲量與互動拆分分析，直接指導代理商向客戶建議 TikTok 與跨平台內容預算的配置方式。
items.why_en: Real sponsorship data showing the split between mention volume and platform-specific engagement directly informs how agencies should advise clients to allocate TikTok versus cross-platform content budgets.
highlights: 阿迪達斯以 9,439 次提及奪 2026 F1 新加坡站網路聲量第一，DHL 排名第二；互動量最高的贊助商則是阿美科，錄得約 30.1 萬次互動。
新加坡航空以 TikTok 佔比高達 75% 的互動逆轉排名，顯示平台專注策略在互動深度上可彌補整體聲量的不足。
此案例清晰說明聲量排名與互動排名可以截然不同，贊助商需按目標（品牌知名度 vs. 受眾互動）選擇對應的平台策略。
highlights_en: Adidas led the 2026 F1 Singapore GP with 9,439 mentions, followed by DHL; Aramco topped engagement with approximately 301,000 interactions despite lower mention volume.
Singapore Airlines drove 75% of its interactions through TikTok, showing how platform-focused strategy can offset lower overall mention volume with deeper audience engagement.
The case clearly demonstrates that mention rankings and engagement rankings can diverge sharply — sponsors must choose platform strategies aligned with their specific objectives.
items.detail:
Meltwater 針對 2026 年 F1 新加坡大獎賽進行為期 14 天的網路監測，追蹤範圍涵蓋賽事前後的社交媒體聲量與互動數據。數據顯示，阿迪達斯在整個監測窗口錄得逾 9,400 次品牌提及，以及超過 261,000 次互動，排名雙榜第一，成功超越 2025 年聲量冠軍 DHL——後者去年錄得約 5,245 次貼文與轉發。

阿迪達斯的聲量表現，部分源於其在新加坡本地的實體啟動活動：品牌在 Raffles City 與 Funan 商場設置賽車主題快閃活動，展出 Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 車隊與奧迪 Revolut F1 車隊的展示賽車，並推出限定周邊商品。值得注意的是，Meltwater 的報告明確指出，無法確認品牌網路活動有多少比例可直接歸因於上述實體啟動，這提示品牌在詮釋聲量來源時需保持審慎。

新加坡航空的表現揭示了聲量與互動之間的結構性落差。新航錄得 1,471 次提及，排名第三，遠低於阿迪達斯的提及量；互動方面錄得約 145,000 次，同樣排第三。然而，與 2025 年相比，新航提及次數由約 2,733 次下跌，而互動卻由約 83,589 次大幅躍升，增幅顯著。這一反差直接源於 TikTok 的貢獻——平台佔新航 2026 年互動總量的 75%，意味著較少數量的高互動 TikTok 內容，足以在整體互動排名上形成逆轉效應。

整個賽事周期的宏觀數據同樣值得關注：14 天監測期內全體 F1 相關活動共產生約 85,000 次提及與近 2,000 萬次互動。Max Verstappen 的賽場表現帶動了相當比重的賽事週末討論，凸顯出賽場內外的自然熱點如何與贊助商主動製造的聲量相互疊加。分析指出，贊助商在線上競爭中並無單一制勝公式，聲量領先與互動領先所需的平台策略可以截然不同，品牌須根據自身目標選擇相應的指標與戰術重心。
items.detail_en:
Meltwater conducted a 14-day online monitoring exercise for the 2026 Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix, tracking social media mentions and engagement data across the period before and after the race. The data showed that Adidas recorded over 9,400 brand mentions and more than 261,000 engagements across the monitoring window, topping both rankings and surpassing 2025 volume leader DHL, which had recorded approximately 5,245 posts and reposts in the previous year.

Adidas's strong mention performance was partly driven by its physical activation in Singapore: the brand set up motorsport-themed pop-up events at Raffles City and Funan malls, displaying show cars from the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team and Audi Revolut F1 Team, and offered exclusive limited-edition merchandise. Notably, the Meltwater report explicitly stated it could not determine how much of the brand's online activity was directly attributable to these on-ground activations — a caution brands should bear in mind when interpreting the source of their mention volume.

Singapore Airlines' performance revealed a structural divergence between mention volume and engagement. SIA recorded 1,471 mentions, placing third and far below Adidas in raw mention count; it also ranked third in engagement with approximately 145,000 interactions. Yet compared to 2025, SIA's mention count fell from approximately 2,733, while engagements surged dramatically from around 83,589 — a sharp reversal. This contrast stems directly from TikTok's contribution: the platform accounted for 75% of SIA's total 2026 engagements, demonstrating that a smaller number of high-engagement TikTok pieces can overturn overall engagement rankings.

The macro-level data across the full event period also merits attention: across the 14-day monitoring window, all F1-related activity generated approximately 85,000 mentions and nearly 20 million engagements. Max Verstappen's on-track performance drove a significant share of race-weekend conversation, highlighting how organic hotspots inside and outside the circuit interact with and amplify sponsor-generated visibility. The analysis underscores that there is no single formula for winning the online sponsorship race: the platform strategies required to lead on mentions versus engagements can be fundamentally different, and brands must align their chosen metrics with their tactical priorities.

items.title: SQREEM AI 受眾行為分析工具獲納入新加坡政府跨部門採購框架
items.title_en: SQREEM AI Audience Analytics Joins Singapore's Whole-of-Government Digital Framework
items.summary: SQREEM Technologies 獲納入新加坡政府跨部門數位消費分析採購框架，以 AI 行為智能工具協助政府機構分析開放網路上的受眾行為與內容消費趨勢。
items.summary_en: SQREEM Technologies joined Singapore's Whole-of-Government Digital Consumption Analytics procurement framework, providing AI-driven behavioural intelligence tools to help government agencies analyze audience behavior and content consumption across the open web.
items.why: 政府採購認可為代理商評估 SQREEM 等 AI 受眾分析工具的可信度與合規性提供背書，可作為向客戶推薦時的參考依據。
items.why_en: Government procurement validation provides a credibility benchmark for agencies evaluating AI audience analytics tools; useful as a trust signal when recommending similar platforms to clients.
highlights: SQREEM Technologies 獲納入新加坡政府「全政府數位消費分析框架」，成為官方認可的 AI 受眾行為分析供應商。
工具以 AI 行為智能分析開放網路上的受眾行為與內容消費模式，無需依賴 cookie 或個人身份數據。
政府框架認可為 SQREEM 在東南亞商業市場的擴展提供信任背書，代理商可據此評估其在受眾洞察與程序化定向上的應用潛力。
highlights_en: SQREEM Technologies joined Singapore's Whole-of-Government Digital Consumption Analytics framework as an officially endorsed AI audience behaviour analytics vendor.
The tool analyzes audience behavior and content consumption patterns across the open web using AI behavioural intelligence, without relying on cookies or personal identity data.

Government framework endorsement provides a trust signal for SQREEM's commercial expansion across Southeast Asia; agencies can use this as a benchmark when evaluating its audience insights and programmatic targeting capabilities.
items.detail:
新加坡數位發展及新聞部（MDDI）於 2026 年 10 月 12 日宣布，SQREEM Technologies 獲納入政府跨部門數位消費分析服務採購框架協議（Whole-of-Government Digital Consumption Analytics Services Period Contract and Framework Agreement）。這一框架旨在讓各政府機構以統一採購路徑取得數位分析服務，支援其研究、傳播及決策工作，是新加坡政府推動跨部門傳播協調的整體佈局之一。

SQREEM Technologies 的核心能力在於分析開放網路上的大規模行為訊號。其工具可覆蓋受眾行為追蹤、內容消費模式分析、新興趨勢識別、人口結構與地理分佈，以及數位影響力來源的探測，所有分析均在適用的私隱與數據保護法規框架內進行。政府機構透過這一框架，可掌握公眾如何在網絡上消費資訊，以及數位興趣隨時間如何演變，從而為政策傳播與公眾溝通策略提供更具實據的依據。

SQREEM 創辦人 René Raiss 將此次獲納入框架形容為「重要里程碑」，並表示公司致力於「打造受信任的技術，協助組織在日益複雜的數位環境中理清方向」。這一表述呼應了政府機構在選擇第三方分析合作夥伴時，日益看重工具的可信度與合規性，而非單純的技術性能。

從更宏觀的背景看，SQREEM 此次的採購框架入選，與新加坡政府另一項由 KPMG 主導的媒體採購面板招標同步推進，顯示出政府在整合數位傳播基礎設施方面的系統性佈局。AI 行為智能工具進入政府採購鏈條，亦標誌著此類技術在公共部門的應用逐步從概念驗證走向制度化落地，對同類商業應用場景亦具有一定的參考意義。
items.detail_en:
Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI) announced on 12 October 2026 that SQREEM Technologies has been appointed under the Whole-of-Government Digital Consumption Analytics Services Period Contract and Framework Agreement. This framework enables government agencies to procure digital analytics services through a unified procurement pathway, supporting their research, communications, and decision-making functions — forming part of Singapore's broader push for coordinated whole-of-government communications.

SQREEM Technologies' core capability lies in analysing large-scale behavioural signals across the open web. Its tools cover audience behaviour tracking, content consumption pattern analysis, emerging trend identification, demographic and geographic profiling, and the detection of digital influence sources — all conducted within applicable privacy and data protection regulatory frameworks. Through this arrangement, government agencies gain the ability to understand how the public consumes information online and how digital interests shift over time, providing a more evidence-based foundation for policy communication and public engagement strategies.

SQREEM founder René Raiss described the appointment as 'an important milestone,' stating that the company is committed to 'building trusted technology that helps organisations make sense of an increasingly complex digital environment.' This framing reflects a growing emphasis among government clients on the credibility and compliance posture of third-party analytics partners, not just technical performance.

Viewed in broader context, SQREEM's inclusion in this procurement framework runs alongside a separate media buying panel tender administered by KPMG on behalf of the Singapore government, indicating a systematic effort to consolidate the government's digital communications infrastructure. The entry of AI behavioural intelligence tools into the government procurement chain also marks a step-change in how such technologies are applied in the public sector — moving from proof-of-concept engagements toward institutionalised deployment, with implications that carry reference value for analogous commercial applications.

items.title: Canva 與清揚以「社群先於名人」策略進入新市場，打造更持久的代言效應
items.title_en: Canva and Clear Men Make the Case for Fans-First Community Strategy Over Celebrity-Led Market Entry
items.summary: 在全球行銷峰會 All That Matters 上，Canva 與聯合利華旗下清揚的代表指出，品牌進入新市場應先建立社群連結，再以社群力量放大名人合作效益，而非單靠明星光環拉動知名度。
items.summary_en: At All That Matters 2026 in Singapore, Canva and Unilever's Clear Men brand argued that brands entering new markets should build community connections first, then amplify celebrity partnerships through that community — rather than relying on celebrity reach alone.
items.why: 「社群先於名人」的進市場框架可直接應用於 HK 代理商為客戶制定 KOL 合作策略，尤其在評估代言人 ROI 與受眾連結深度時。
items.why_en: The 'fans-first, celebrity-second' market entry framework can be directly applied by HK agencies when structuring KOL partnership strategies for clients entering new markets.
highlights: Canva 與清揚在峰會上主張品牌進入新市場應優先建立社群基礎，令名人合作效益得以透過已有的粉絲紐帶放大，而非由零開始買觸及率。
清揚（Unilever）案例顯示，先建立社群後引入代言人，可令代言人內容的自發擴散率顯著高於傳統明星廣告模式。
此框架對在亞太市場運用 KOL 合作的代理商具參考價值，尤其在評估「社群型 KOL」與「流量型明星」的不同投資回報時。
highlights_en: Canva and Clear Men at All That Matters 2026 argued brands should build community foundations first, enabling celebrity partnerships to be amplified through existing fan networks rather than buying reach from scratch.
Clear Men's case study showed that introducing a celebrity into an established community generates significantly higher organic sharing rates than traditional celebrity ad placement.
The framework is directly applicable for agencies structuring KOL strategies in Asia-Pacific, particularly when evaluating community KOLs versus traffic-driven celebrity endorsements.
items.detail:
在 2026 年於新加坡舉行的全球行銷峰會 All That Matters 上，Canva 代表 Laura Kantor 與聯合利華旗下清揚（Clear Men）代表 Andrea Cappi，就品牌進入新市場的策略路徑分享了各自的實踐觀察。兩人的核心立場高度一致：社群連結應先於名人合作，成為品牌落地的第一步；名人的傳播力，只有在社群基礎已經建立的情況下，才能以倍增而非線性的方式釋放。

這一「社群先行」邏輯的實踐背景，在 Canva 的案例中尤為明顯。Canva 作為一個設計工具平台，其市場拓展歷來依賴使用者社群的口碑傳遞與創作分享，品牌認知往往在正式廣告投放之前，就已在設計師、教育者、創業者等特定社群中形成。這種有機滲透使得後續名人或意見領袖的背書，能夠落在已有信任根基的土壤上，而非懸空的傳播氣泡中。

清揚的角度則從快消品牌在亞洲新興市場的進入邏輯出發。聯合利華旗下品牌在東南亞及南亞市場的長期實踐顯示，消費者對品牌的信任建立往往源於貼近日常生活的社區接觸點，而非由上而下的明星宣傳。Andrea Cappi 的觀點指向一個結構性轉變：名人合作的角色，從「創造知名度的引爆點」轉化為「放大已有社群動能的訊號源」，兩者在邏輯上是根本不同的。

峰會上兩個品牌的討論，折射出一個更廣泛的行業趨勢：隨著消費者對純廣告訊息的信任度持續下滑，以及社群平台演算法愈來愈傾向放大真實互動而非付費曝光，品牌在新市場的初期建設策略正在系統性地從「知名度優先」轉向「歸屬感優先」。這對代言合約的結構設計、啟動時序的規劃，以及衡量成功的指標體系，都帶來了值得深究的重新思考空間。
items.detail_en:
At the All That Matters global marketing summit held in Singapore in 2026, Laura Kantor from Canva and Andrea Cappi from Unilever's Clear Men brand shared their respective observations on strategic approaches to entering new markets. Both speakers aligned closely on a central proposition: community connection should precede celebrity partnerships as the first step when a brand enters a new market, and celebrity reach only multiplies — rather than scales linearly — when built on an established community foundation.

This 'community-first' logic is particularly evident in Canva's case. As a design tools platform, Canva's market expansion has historically relied on word-of-mouth and creative sharing within user communities, with brand recognition often taking root among designers, educators, and entrepreneurs before any formal advertising investment. This organic penetration means that subsequent celebrity or influencer endorsements land on soil where trust already exists, rather than in an empty broadcast vacuum.

Clear Men's perspective approached the issue from the angle of fast-moving consumer goods entry into Asian emerging markets. Unilever brands' long-term experience across Southeast and South Asian markets suggests that consumer trust in a brand is often built through community touchpoints close to everyday life, rather than through top-down celebrity campaigns. Andrea Cappi's framing pointed to a structural shift: the role of celebrity partnerships moves from 'igniting awareness from scratch' to 'amplifying existing community momentum' — a fundamentally different logic with different implications for execution.

The discussion between these two brands at the summit reflects a broader industry trend: as consumer trust in pure advertising messages continues to decline, and as social platform algorithms increasingly favour genuine interaction over paid reach, brands' early-stage market-building strategies are systematically shifting from 'awareness-first' to 'belonging-first.' This shift has meaningful implications worth examining closely for how endorsement contracts are structured, how activation timelines are sequenced, and how success metrics are defined.
